_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for token unit prices (USD per 1M tokens). Read by agents-dashboard-aggregate.py (cost calc) AND dashboard-selfcheck.py (drift audit). Order: [input, output, cacheWrite, cacheRead]. Do NOT hardcode prices elsewhere. When a price changes, edit here only. Each entry carries source + verified date + confidence so drift is auditable.

_schema.confidence: official = price verifiable on vendor public pricing page (verification method only; for aigw/internal gateways actual settlement may differ, e.g. Accenture EA discount) | internal = aigw/azure private endpoint, no public page | estimated = best-guess, MUST re-verify
